templatesStatus.reason: The restored adl.config.example.json predates this project's schema and is rejected by it with 12 UNKNOWN_FIELD issues: it nests features as {enabled, onUnavailable}, names limits differently (decisionDeadlineMs, maxConcurrentPerProvider, maxRequestsPerTurn, maxInputBytes), splits audit into rawState/publicDiagnostics, points calibration at an artifact path, and carries only provider.kind=unconfigured with no local/typesafe block at all. It is kept unedited as the handoff original for reference. The implementation's own examples live in config/examples/ and are validated through loadConfig by packages/core/test/unit/config-examples.test.ts, which also cross-checks the local example against python/models.lock.json.
